tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in both modes. Light is the warm paper of the pitch deck.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, dialogs, table bodies and the printed receipt slip.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: input backgrounds, table header rows, the code-entry field.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, and the fill of completed stage dots.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, hints, captions, table metadata.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers inside cards. Never the only edge of a control or the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons) and the ring of upcoming stage dots.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: The signature accent as a fill: primary buttons and large brand areas, with on-accent text. Never as text. In light mode never a small mark on its own.

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Small orange marks that carry meaning: the current stage dot and its halo, the active tab indicator.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text: the current stage label and rare inline emphasis.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-orange fills. Navy, not white: white on this orange fails AA.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on light and standard surfaces: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: The focus ring on surface-inverse (batch pill, hero card, receipt pass), where focus would be too dark to see.

tokens.name: stage-done
tokens.usage: The filled part of the timeline line and the fill behind completed rows. Decorative: dots and labels carry the state.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange fill behind the current stage row and the current-stage badge.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark floating surfaces: the tracker hero card, the digital receipt pass, the batch action pill.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text, icons and completed stage dots on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and upcoming stage rings on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: status-challenged
tokens.usage: Challenged (Under review): text, dot and flag icon.

tokens.name: status-challenged-bg
tokens.usage: Challenged badge and callout fill.

tokens.name: status-discarded
tokens.usage: Discarded (Not counted) and failed integrity checks: text, dot and X icon.

tokens.name: status-discarded-bg
tokens.usage: Discarded badge and failed-check callout fill.

tokens.name: status-spoiled
tokens.usage: Spoiled: text, dot and return-arrow icon.

tokens.name: status-spoiled-bg
tokens.usage: Spoiled badge fill.

contrast.standard: WCAG 2.2 AA. Text 4.5:1 (14px bold or 18px regular and larger may use 3:1, but no pair here relies on that). Non-text marks and control edges 3:1.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The single status headline at the top of a voter screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Marion County included your ballot in its election-night results.
styles.usage: Every voter-facing sentence. Voter screens never set sentences smaller.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and field labels. Never a sentence.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mark 412 ballots as counted at Precinct 12?

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, metadata and hints. Admin only.

styles.name: code-lg
styles.usage: A tracking code shown on its own: receipt, tracker, code entry.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Hashes, record IDs and codes inside tables and proof details.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; dot to badge text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding; gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between timeline rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones and the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wider screens; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above the voter status headline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, chips, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero surfaces: the tracker hero card and the receipt pass.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, stage dots, the floating batch pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Cards separate from the page by elevation, not borders.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Things that float: the batch pill, dialogs, the receipt pass, toasts.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Badges changing status, the batch pill entering, drawers.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The timeline line filling to a newly reached stage.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or settles.
